mapper.select: WITH vv AS ( SELECT v.employee_id, COUNT(*) AS visits FROM visit v WHERE v.status = '已完成' AND v.arrival_time >= #{start} AND v.arrival_time < #{end} GROUP BY v.employee_id ), ii AS ( SELECT v.employee_id, COUNT(vt.vt_id) AS items FROM visit v JOIN visit_treatment vt ON vt.visit_id = v.visit_id WHERE v.status = '已完成' AND v.arrival_time >= #{start} AND v.arrival_time < #{end} GROUP BY v.employee_id ), rev AS ( SELECT COALESCE(v.employee_id, ov.employee_id) AS employee_id, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_due), 0) AS revenue FROM statement s LEFT JOIN visit v ON v.visit_id = s.visit_id LEFT JOIN statement o ON o.statement_id = s.reversal_of_id LEFT JOIN visit ov ON ov.visit_id = o.visit_id WHERE s.status IN ('已出具', '待支付', '已结算') AND s.issue_date >= #{start} AND s.issue_date < #{end} GROUP BY COALESCE(v.employee_id, ov.employee_id) ) SELECT d.employee_id AS employee_id, e.full_name AS dentist_name, (SELECT string_agg(c.clinic_name, '、' ORDER BY c.clinic_id) FROM dentist_clinic dc JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = dc.clinic_id WHERE dc.employee_id = d.employee_id) AS clinic_names, COALESCE(vv.visits, 0) AS visits, COALESCE(ii.items, 0) AS items, COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM dentist d JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = d.employee_id LEFT JOIN vv ON vv.employee_id = d.employee_id LEFT JOIN ii ON ii.employee_id = d.employee_id LEFT JOIN rev ON rev.employee_id = d.employee_id WHERE COALESCE(vv.visits, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) <> 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(rev.revenue, 0) DESC
